mentions.name: Cascade Editor
mentions.description: A free node-based image editor that works with image sequences and has an associated desktop app. It runs in the browser using wgpu and WebAssembly, with everything cross-compiled from Rust.
mentions.source_excerpt: cascade-editor.pages.dev - a free node-based image editor that works with image sequences and has an associated desktop app. It’s pretty incredible what you can do in browser these days with wgpu and wasm- everything is cross compiled from rust.
